systems.country_label: annual real estate tax of the Real Estate Tax Authority
systems.owner: Real Estate Tax Authority, Ministry of Finance
systems.tiers: national, with local RETA offices; the document says 25 percent of the tax goes to local government and 75 percent to the treasury and the ISDF

note: Property tax is assessed and collected by the central tax authority, with local governments holding almost no own-source revenue; no local government revenue record stated.
